about.title: About Anston
body: Anston is an all-in-one marketplace where anyone can buy, bid on, rent or sell almost anything, from vehicles and homes to clothes, food and services.
Anston LLC is based in Houston, Texas, and is built for buyers and sellers around the world, in English, Arabic, Spanish, Chinese, French and Urdu.

howItWorks.title: How it works
body: List an item, property or service and choose how to offer it: sell it at a fixed price, auction it, rent it out or take bookings.
Buyers find it through search and categories, message you, and pay securely on Anston.
After the deal, buyers and sellers review each other.

pricing.title: Pricing
body: There are no selling fees at launch. Any future fees will be shown clearly before you list.

items.q: What can I sell on Anston?
items.a: Almost anything legal: vehicles, homes, clothes, jewelry, furniture, equipment, homemade food that follows local rules, and services. Some items, like weapons and drugs, are not allowed.

items.q: Can I rent things out instead of selling?
items.a: Yes. When you list, choose sell, auction, rent or booking. You can choose more than one.
Payments will be made securely on Anston when checkout opens.
